title: VOLTHAVEN
note: Switched to building directly rather than fanning out builders. Materials and the city generator are now written and the render pipeline is debugged end to end. The street reads as a real place in the raw scene buffer; the remaining problem is lighting balance in the post chain.
blockers: Wave 1 fan-out (10 parallel builders) exhausted the account session limit and all ten were killed. Now building sequentially in the main session.
GitHub repo creation returned 403 (no repo-creation scope on this app). Work is on claude/cyberpunk-threejs-game-aytbja in clonevpn333-bot/game.
cdnjs blocked by egress policy; shipped HTML still targets cdnjs, capture harness serves an identical r128 locally.

No image host is reachable (only raw.githubusercontent.com), so a grader subagent cannot be handed an actual Cyberpunk 2077 screenshot. The gauntlet will run against a named reference scene the grader describes from memory before seeing our frame.

pieces.name: Render core & post FX
pieces.gap: Pipeline debugged with a new pixel probe and a per-buffer viewer (?showpass=). Found and fixed: volumetric in-scatter had no scattering coefficient (fog buffer was a wall of white); bloom gain accumulated ~30x across the mip chain. Raw scene and resolve buffers are now correct and filmic. Remaining: the sky still reads too bright relative to the street, and the road is under-lit.

shots.label: Raw scene buffer (pre-post)
shots.note: This is the geometry and lighting before post — dark street, lit windows, warm glow down the canyon.

shots.label: Final composite, Undertide
shots.note: Post chain applied. Sky too bright, road under-lit — the current largest gap.

pieces.name: Procedural materials
pieces.gap: Written: wet asphalt with puddle roughness mask, concrete with downward staining and rust bleed, panelled/rusted metal, lit-window generator, neon sign generator (tube/matrix/backlit/painted), skin, fabric, chrome, water, holo. Not yet validated in a showcase render.

pieces.name: City generation
pieces.gap: Seven districts parameterised; Undertide built and rendering at 213 draw calls / 16k tris. Facades use a plinth-floors-crown system with shanty additions, fire escapes, AC units, catenary cables, blade signs, steam, rain, and a distant skyline. Cover points and colliders emitted. Needs the other six districts verified and crowd/vehicles added.

log.detail: Wrote 20_materials.js and 30_world.js directly (no subagents). First city street renders.

Root-caused the white-frame bug with a render-target pixel probe: volumetric in-scatter accumulated light with no scattering coefficient, and bloom summed ~30x across six mips. Both fixed; raw scene buffer confirmed correct.
Ten builders launched in parallel across ten files.
All ten terminated: account session limit exhausted. Root cause is fan-out width, not any individual agent.
Salvaged 10_core.js (1537 lines, sound architecture) and 70_story.js (509 lines, 4 missions). 50_combat.js was truncated and reverted to stub.
